display_name: Superior Attuned Superior Spiders Bite F
help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Gives most Soldiers of Arachnos damaging powers a 12% chance to deal a minor amount of Toxic damage and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%. This enhancement can only be slotted by Soldiers of Arachnos and may be slotted into any Arachnos Soldier or Arachnos Widow damage power.
power_display_names: (Soldier of Arachnos) Superior Spider's Bite: Recharge/Global Chance for Toxic DMG
power_short_helps: Increases Attack Rate and Global Chance for Minor DMG(Toxic)
